summary: Load full corpus via guru-corpus.sql.gz into production Postgres

resolution.note: Superseded by the deployment that actually shipped. This ticket is from the 2026-04-17 Phase-7 plan, which assumed Vercel; production instead runs self-hosted on a Hetzner VPS behind Caddy + Cloudflare (README.md:50, 'no Vercel'), with systemd units, Caddyfile, deploy.sh, backup.sh and an incident-response runbook under deploy/. Closing as obsolete rather than done — the work happened, by a different route. Additionally, loading the corpus turned out not to be a one-off milestone: it is the recurring corpus-push ritual the owner performs per corpus version (v55 is the current artifact, unshipped), gated by scripts/sync_corpus.sh which agents never run. Tracking it as a launch task misrepresents it as finishable.
